summary: This bill requires the Attorney General to establish a grant program to provide eligible nonprofit organizations with up to $575,000 annually to help cover the medical expenses of retired federal working dogs and service dogs assisting veterans or retired federal law enforcement officers.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a grant program to assist with medical expenses for retired working dogs, including those that served with the Armed Forces. While it provides support for military working dogs, it does not directly increase or decrease military spending or affect defense policy, focusing instead on post-service care.
